title: Analista SR de Consolidação (Contabilidade)
description:
Analista SR de Consolidação (Contabilidade) - Posição Hibrida - Barueri/SP

Atuar de forma técnica, analítica e estratégica nas rotinas da Consolidação, sendo responsável pela integridade, consistência e interpretação das informações contábeis e gerenciais. O cargo tem como missão assegurar a correta aplicação das normas contábeis e regulatórias, liderar tecnicamente os processos de fechamento, reporte e aplicabilidade de novas normas contábeis, apoiar a tomada de decisão da gestão e contribuir ativamente para a evolução dos processos da área, em um ambiente regulado.

Atuação estratégica na liderança da implementação das novas normas contábeis (IFRS S1, S2 e IFRS 18) e controle societário, incluindo compra e transferência de ações, juros, dividendos e aportes de capital. Responsável pela consolidação de balanços e elaboração das demonstrações financeiras consolidadas e notas explicativas, garantindo conformidade com CPCs e IFRS aplicáveis (CPC 01, CPC 05, CPC 18, CPC 36, ICPC 09 - DESEJÁVEL).

Revisão de cálculos de equivalência patrimonial, conciliações e materiais para governança (Conselho e acionistas). Comunicação direta com acionistas, atendimento a auditorias internas e externas, participação em reuniões para esclarecimentos e suporte na definição de políticas e procedimentos contábeis. Apoio à liderança da equipe (Pleno e Júnior), com experiência desejável em concessões e ambientes regulados.

Requisitos: formação em Contabilidade, sólida experiência em consolidação, domínio de normas IFRS/CPC, Excel avançado, ERP e Power BI. Perfil analítico, comunicação técnica clara, senso de responsabilidade e visão de melhoria contínua.

title: Financial And Administrative Manager
description:
The Financial and Administrative Manager will be responsible for the integrated management of the company's financial, administrative, and operational support areas, ensuring control, efficiency, compliance, and financial sustainability of the business. This role will operate both strategically and operationally, supporting leadership in decision-making and organizing internal processes.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management

  • Plan, control, and monitor cash flow (short, medium, and long term)
  • Prepare and track budget, forecast, and variance analyses
  • Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bank reconciliations
  • Monitor financial indicators (KPIs) and prepare management reports
  • Support the board in financial feasibility analysis and decision-making
  • Interface with accounting, auditing, and financial institutions

Administrative Management

  • Manage contracts with suppliers, service providers, and partners
  • Supervise administrative routines, payments, invoicing, and documentation
  • Ensure organization and standardization of internal processes
  • Support internal policies (purchases, reimbursements, travel, contracts, etc.)
  • Ensure deadlines, controls, and administrative best practices are met

Compliance, Controls, and Governance

  • Ensure compliance with legal, tax, and labor regulations (in partnership with accounting/legal)
  • Implement and maintain internal controls and financial policies
  • Support internal and external audits
  • Safeguard confidentiality and security of financial information

Requirements

Mandatory

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Economics, or related fields
  • Strong experience in administrative and financial management
  • Solid knowledge of cash flow, budgeting, and financial reporting
  • Experience in contract and supplier management
  • Proficiency in Excel and financial too
  • Organized, analytical, and results-oriented profile

Preferred

  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Finance, Controllership, or Management
  • Experience in mid-sized companies or startups
  • Knowledge of ERP systems
  • Intermediate/advanced English or Spanish

Behavioral Competencies

  • Strategic vision and ownership mindset
  • Analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Clear and objective communication
  • Proactivity and autonomy
  • Collaborative leadership
  • Ethics, confidentiality, and responsibility

Differentials

  • Experience in dynamic and fast-growing environments
  • Background in lean financial structures
  • Ability to build processes from scratch or improve existing ones

title: Integration Manager (SM-IDI)
description:
Job Title: Technical Lead – SampleManager LIMS

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Technical Lead – SampleManager LIMS to lead and deliver implementation and enhancement projects on the Thermo Fisher SampleManager platform. The role involves driving technical execution, collaborating closely with clients and internal stakeholders, and ensuring high-quality, compliant, and timely delivery of solutions in line with company standards and SOPs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical delivery of SampleManager LIMS implementation and enhancement projects.
  • Act as a client-facing technical expert to understand business needs and propose effective solutions.
  • Conduct requirement-gathering workshops and create clear, detailed specification documents.
  • Design, develop, configure, and implement system enhancements and modifications.
  • Ensure on-time delivery while adhering to company standards, SOPs, and quality guidelines.
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to internal team members.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable and high-quality technical designs.
  • Support best development practices including peer code reviews, unit testing, and documentation.
  • Participate across the full system lifecycle: design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and support.
  • Collaborate with multiple internal teams and client stakeholders simultaneously.

Technical Scope

Hands-on development and configuration in the following areas:

  • Sample workflows
  • Stock & Instrument modules
  • Instrument interfacing using Integration Manager
  • Report Designer, Forms Designer, Label Designer
  • Sample Scheduler
  • Batch Management, Lot Management, Plate Handling
  • Stability, SQC, SM-IDI, PIMS, Dashboards

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in SampleManager LIMS implementation and support.
  • Extensive hands-on expertise in developing and configuring SampleManager solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of systems analysis, design, development, QA, and integration methodologies.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with minimal supervision in project environments.
  • Excellent attention to detail and time-management skills.
  • Strong communication skills; English proficiency required (Spanish is a plus).
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and delivery-focused team player.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving priorities.
  • Strong ownership mindset with commitment to successful project completion.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in regulated environments (GxP, Pharma, Life Sciences).
  • Exposure to integrations with instruments and enterprise systems.
  • Experience working in global delivery models and with cross-functional teams.

title: Data Migration Specialist
description:
Data Engineer

Location: Brazil, Fully Remote

Type: Full-time (8 hours/day)

Setup: Consultancy / Freelance

Level: Senior-Mid Level

Industry: Software IT / SaaS

Shift: EST Time Zone

Equipment: Must have own machine; equipment not provided

Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize data migration pipelines that enable seamless transitions from legacy systems into our SaaS platform. You will work closely with both customers and internal teams to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and long-term scalability across our product ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement ETL/ELT pipelines to migrate customer data from various legacy systems into the SDL SaaS platform
  • Transform datasets across multiple formats (e.g., SQL databases, APIs, flat files like CSV) ensuring data integrity and consistency
  • Build reusable components and tooling that support repeatable and scalable migration processes
  • Automate data extraction, transformation, and loading workflows to improve performance and efficiency
  • Partner with customers and cross-functional teams to deeply understand data requirements and resolve data-related challenges
  • Apply best practices in code quality, testing, CI/CD, and deployment to maintain a robust engineering ecosystem
  • Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to evolving engineering standards as we scale
  • Support ongoing process improvement by helping build foundational data engineering capabilities

Job Requirements

  • Proven experience in data engineering, ETL development, or data migration within a SaaS environment
  • Proficiency in Python for data transformation and automation scripting
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of SQL and experience working with relational databases
  • Ability to work with multiple data formats (e.g., CSV, structured/unstructured sources)
  • Strong analytical mindset with high attention to data accuracy and quality
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Knowledge of software development best practices, including version control and code reviews

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GIS technologies and spatial data formats such as shapefiles
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure)
  • Experience building scalable data pipelines and automating complex workflows
  • Understanding of distributed systems or large-scale data processing architectures

title: Executivo(a) de Vendas Jr. (Pet Food)

A Barentz é uma distribuidora líder global de ingredientes de alto desempenho para ciências biológicas. Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. Com um volume de negócios de 2,5 mil milhões de euros, a empresa emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em todo o mundo e serve mais de 25.000 clientes. Para mais informações visite nosso site:

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Sênior
description:
Pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack Sênior

Na Serena Energia, usamos tecnologia para viabilizar a transição para uma matriz energética mais limpa, eficiente e sustentável. Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais que conectam a geração de energia renovável à comercialização para clientes finais, atendendo milhares de consumidores, de residências a grandes data centers, no Brasil e nos EUA.

Atuamos em um dos mercados mais regulados e complexos do mundo, o que exige sistemas robustos, escaláveis e confiáveis. Por isso, buscamos uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Fullstack Sênior para atuar na evolução de sistemas distribuídos estratégicos para o negócio, com alto impacto real na operação e nos clientes.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir aplicações fullstack baseadas em sistemas distribuídos;
  • Atuar na definição e evolução da arquitetura, aplicando SOLID, DDD e Clean Architecture;
  • Desenvolver backends e APIs escaláveis, seguras e resilientes;
  • Trabalhar com PostgreSQL, SQL avançado e MongoDB, garantindo performance e integridade dos dados;
  • Projetar e implementar integrações entre sistemas e aplicações;
  • Atuar em ambientes AWS, com arquiteturas cloud-native e serviços gerenciados;
  • Colaborar com times de produto, dados, operações e negócio na tomada de decisões técnicas;
  • Garantir requisitos não funcionais como performance, disponibilidade, segurança e observabilidade;
  • Utilizar inteligência artificial de forma recorrente no desenvolvimento, revisão de código, automação, análise e documentação;
  • Contribuir para padrões técnicos, diretrizes e melhoria contínua da plataforma.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • +5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência prática com sistemas distribuídos e arquiteturas cloud-native;
  • Domínio de PostgreSQL, SQL avançado e experiência com MongoDB;
  • Forte base em boas práticas de engenharia (SOLID, DDD, Clean Architecture);
  • Experiência com REST APIs, CI/CD e observabilidade;
  • Capacidade de avaliar trade-offs técnicos e propor soluções alinhadas ao negócio;
  • Uso consistente de IA aplicada ao desenvolvimento de software.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência no setor de energia, utilities ou ambientes altamente regulados;
  • Vivência com event-driven architecture e sistemas de mensageria;
  • Experiência com modernização de sistemas legados;
  • Ser heavy user e entusiasta de IA no desenvolvimento de software.

Por que Serena?

Na Serena, você terá ownership técnico real, atuará em produtos estratégicos para a transição energética e fará parte da transformação digital de uma indústria crítica para o futuro da sociedade. Estamos em uma jornada para nos tornar uma AI Coding Company, usando inteligência artificial para potencializar produtividade, qualidade de código e velocidade de entrega. Trabalhamos com times pequenos e autônomos, alta autonomia técnica, e valorizamos curiosidade, pensamento crítico e evolução contínua.

title: Internal Consultant
description:
A Oportunidade

A MyCareforce/Clicknurse está em um momento acelerado de crescimento, conectando profissionais de saúde a oportunidades de trabalho no Brasil e em Portugal. Já cobrimos +1.200.000 horas de enfermagem conectando +21.000 profissionais a +300 unidades de saúde. Somos uma empresa de tecnologia em crescimento (+€3.3M investimento) com uma missão clara: melhorar a qualidade dos cuidados de saúde.

Estamos buscando um Consultor Interno com forte viés analítico para se juntar ao nosso time no Brasil.

Esta não é uma posição operacional padrão. Estamos procurando alguém com a mentalidade de um consultor estratégico – alguém que não apenas manuseie dados, mas que consiga mergulhar neles para extrair insights que direcionarão o sucesso dos nossos clientes (hospitais e unidades de saúde) e o crescimento do nosso negócio.

Se você tem 1-2 anos de experiência, uma capacidade analítica acima da média e fome de impactar um negócio em escala, essa vaga é para você.

Sobre a Função

Você reportará diretamente ao Head de Strategy & Planning, tendo alta exposição à liderança da empresa. Seu papel principal será atuar como o "motor de inteligência" da área, analisando dados internos e de mercado de ambas as geografias (BR e PT) para identificar onde podemos gerar mais valor.

Inicialmente, o foco será na geração de inteligência estratégica (back-office) para municiar os times internos - Operações e Comercial. No entanto, existe um caminho claro de evolução: à medida que você demonstrar senioridade e domínio do negócio, passará a ter exposição direta a clientes, participando de reuniões com executivos para apresentar suas análises.

Esta é uma posição com alto potencial de crescimento, podendo evoluir a médio prazo para uma posição de Gerência de BizOps, à medida que a nossa abordagem consultiva se torna cada vez mais central para o sucesso do cliente.

O Que Você Fará

  • Deep Dive Analítico: Realizar análises profundas e recorrentes dos dados operacionais dos nossos clientes para entender padrões de comportamento, gargalos e tendências de utilização da plataforma.
  • Geração de Insights Acionáveis: Ir além dos números para identificar proativamente oportunidades de negócio: como podemos aumentar o "share of wallet" nos clientes atuais? Onde estão as oportunidades de melhoria nos nossos serviços? Quais são as necessidades não atendidas dos clientes?
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Buscar, compilar e analisar dados externos de mercado (Brasil e Portugal) para complementar as análises internas e trazer benchmarks relevantes.
  • Comunicação de Alto Impacto: Traduzir análises complexas em relatórios e apresentações executivas (Google Slides/PPT) que sejam claras, "insightful" e que contem uma história convincente para embasar decisões estratégicas.
  • Suporte Estratégico: Atuar como braço direito analítico do Head de Operações, fornecendo dados rápidos e precisos para a tomada de decisão em um ambiente de prioridades dinâmicas.

Quem Você É

  • Experiência: Você possui de 1 a 2 anos de experiência profissional, preferencialmente em consultorias de gestão/estratégicas, ou em áreas de inteligência de negócios/BizOps em startups de alto crescimento.
  • Hard Skills Essenciais:
  • Domínio sólido de Google Sheets/Excel (você será testado nisso).
  • Conhecimento prático em SQL para extração e manipulação de dados.
  • Excelente capacidade de escrita e criação de apresentações estruturadas.
  • Domínio do Inglês
  • Mentalidade Analítica: Você é movido por dados e tem uma curiosidade intelectual aguçada para entender o "porquê" por trás dos números.
  • Perfil Comportamental: Você possui alta disposição para trabalhar em um ambiente de demanda intensa, com prioridades que mudam rapidamente. Você é autônomo, resiliente e tem senso de urgência.
  • Diferencial: Experiência prévia ou conhecimento do mercado de saúde (BR ou PT) será considerado uma vantagem.

O Que Oferecemos

  • Contratação modelo PJ com remuneração competitiva.
  • Possibilidade de Stock Options (equity) atreladas à performance.
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido em São Paulo (3 dias presenciais, 2 remotos).
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, com autonomia e exposição direta à liderança sênior.
  • Oportunidade real de crescimento acelerado e evolução de carreira (ex: trilha para Gerência de BizOps).

title: Especialista Fiscal (ERP)
description:
Nós da Odoo acreditamos que softwares para gerenciar negócios devem cobrir necessidades complexas sem serem complicados. Somos um conjunto de aplicativos de negócios em código aberto que cobre todas as necessidades das pequenas e médias empresas: CRM, e-commerce, contabilidade, estoque... Para isso, você será a linha de frente, analisando as necessidades dos clientes, projetando a solução, configurando os fluxos fiscais, e fornecendo sessões de treinamento. Sua atuação é crucial para garantir que os projetos sejam entregues dentro do prazo e do orçamento, além de ser um ponto importante de apoio para o time de P.O. de Localização Brasileira.

Também será responsável por manter atualizada a nossa base de conhecimento dos fluxos de localização brasileira, facilitando a autonomia do cliente após a implementação.

Basicamente, você será responsável por fornecer a melhor solução de gerenciamento fiscal/contábil aos seus clientes, prestando suporte interno com as demandas fiscais e tributárias necessárias para facilitar os negócios dos nossos clientes, apoiando PMEs de diversos setores a extrair o máximo valor da Odoo. Atuamos com foco no usuário, de maneira ágil, dinâmica e sempre pensando no longo prazo.

Responsabilidades e dia a dia:

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com os clientes durante a implementação do Odoo.
  • Analisar as necessidades do cliente e os requisitos fiscais e contábeis.
  • Prestar apoio para time interno de Analistas de Negócios e Time Comercial com dúvidas e validações contábeis/fiscais.
  • Garantir que os projetos estão em conformidade com as fundamentações fiscais corretas através da operacionalização no Portal Avalara (será treinado).

  • Documentar os cenários de validação fiscal dos projetos, gerar relatórios e documentações dos fluxos fiscais para documentação interna e documentação de cliente.
  • Atuar diretamente em contato com o P.O. do produto de Localização Brasileira para apoiar em especificações técnicas e testes de funcionalidades e bugfixes.

O que esperamos de você:

title: Logistics & 3PL Operations Specialist
description:
About us

OPPO was founded in 2004 and is one of the global leaders in smart device innovation.

Our footprint covers more than 70 countries and regions, supported by over 300,000 sales outlets and 3,300 official service centers. We employ more than 40,000 dedicated professionals focused on creating a better life for customers worldwide through smarter products and services.

We are looking for experienced talent to join us on this exciting journey!

Responsibilities

1. Strategic Operations & 3PL Governance

  • Manage and govern the end-to-end national warehouse operations executed by 3PL partners, strategically ensuring peak efficiency in all logistics flows (inbound, outbound, and storage).
  • Oversee and optimize daily 3PL activities, implementing key metrics to maximize service levels, inventory accuracy, and processing timeliness.
  • Serve as the technical authority in high-value inventory control, establishing and maintaining rigorous protocols for IMEI/serial number tracking and reconciliation.

2. Regulatory Compliance & Auditing

  • Ensure full regulatory compliance by maintaining flawless consistency between physical goods, information systems, and complex Brazilian tax documentation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, etc.).
  • Conduct advanced, systematic auditing of 3PL adherence to SOPs and safety protocols, initiating corrective actions and driving continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide expert advisory and practical support for NF-e invoicing, freight reconciliation, and assistance with complex ICMS tax reporting processes.

3. Project Management & Global Interface

  • Independently execute and drive key strategic logistics projects (e.g., major WMS/ERP system rollouts, warehouse network expansion) from planning through implementation.
  • Interface directly with the local Chinese team and Global Headquarters to align local operations with global supply chain strategy, acting as the primary subject matter expert in Brazil.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Accounting, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related technical field.
  • Advanced English is mandatory (daily use).
  • Chinese is desirable.
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in Warehouse Management, 3PL Operations, or Logistics roles, with a proven track record of driving process ownership and high-impact results.
  • Demonstrated strategic thinking, exceptional communication, and proven ability to operate with high autonomy and strong results-orientation.

Technical Expertise

  • Expert-level mastery of Brazilian logistics and tax legislation (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e, ICMS).
  • Advanced proficiency in WMS, TMS, and integrated ERP systems.
  • Demonstrated deep experience in managing and controlling high-volume, serialized inventory (IMEI/serial numbers).

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

- Banco de dados **SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, DynamoDB)**.
- Mensageria com **Kafka ou RabbitMQ**.
- Containers e Docker.
- Arquitetura de microsserviços e eventos. Principais Responsabilidades do Desenvolvedor 1. Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento Backend Criar e manter microsserviços escaláveis usando Kotlin (Spring Boot). Implementar monitoramento e logging com AWS CloudWatch e Prometheus. 3. Processamento e Automação de Dados Construir pipelines de processamento de dados com Kafka ou AWS Kinesis. Criar automações e scripts auxiliares em Python para análise de dados, ETL ou machine learning. 4. Segurança e Performance Implementar OAuth2, JWT ou AWS Cognito para autenticação e autorização. Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. DevOps e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. Manter documentação técnica clara e atualizada. Participar de decisões arquiteturais e estratégias de evolução do sistema.

  • Experiência com OmniStudio, aplicando aceleradores prontos para uso e personalizando-os para as necessidades da indústria de energia e serviços públicos;
  • Conhecimento emBusiness Rule Engine (BRE) para otimização de regras de negócios e processos de precificação complexos;
  • Experiência comOrchestration Management (OM), incluindo decomposição de pedidos e desenvolvimento de planos de orquestração para processos complexos e multi-step;
  • Conhecimento emContract Lifecycle Management (CLM) será considerado um diferencial, especialmente para gerenciar contratos ao longo de seu ciclo de vida, da criação à renovação e fechamento;

O termo Conforme + Dominante vem do teste comportamental DISC , que classifica o comportamento das pessoas em quatro perfis principais:

  • D – Dominância
  • I – Influência
  • S – Estabilidade
  • C – Conformidade

No caso, “Conforme + Dominante ” significa que a pessoa tem predominância nas características de Conformidade (C) , mas também apresenta traços de Dominância (D) .

Isso gera um perfil que normalmente é:

Conforme (C) – Característica principal

  • Extremamente organizada
  • Segue processos e padrões
  • Atenta a detalhes
  • Gosta de fazer certo da primeira vez
  • Preocupada com qualidade e precisão

Dominante (D) – Característica secundária

  • Decidida e assertiva
  • Focada em resultados
  • Não tem medo de assumir responsabilidades
  • Capaz de tomar decisões rápidas
  • Sabe cobrar e manter prazos

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore, Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.



Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.



Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.



Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)



Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - Latam
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.
  • Intellectually curious and willing to challenge the status quo.
  • A natural leader who enjoys collaborating with teams to complete ambitious but achievable big goals.
  • Strong interest in a multi-functional career with a readiness to work hard to become a future leader in our global company.
  • Trainees are expected to live our values, our culture, and be ambassadors of the program and future leaders of the organization.

What's in it for you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous benefits package
  • Paid Time Off
  • Career developmental opportunities
  • A company culture that prioritizes internal development

description:

title: Engenheiro De Controle
description:
About Woodgrove


We are a leading provider of energy efficient, innovative equipment, instrumentation, and process control systems to the global mining industry. With companies in Brazil, Chile, Mexico, and South Africa, Woodgrove has built a reputation based on quality, performance, and safety. The company is entrepreneurial, dynamic and our team are driven to succeed. We are looking for like-minded individuals that want to be part of a transformational business.


Role Summary

This role is for a position within the Advanced Process Control (APC) department. The APC department works with mine sites around the world (both remotely and on site) to deploy and integrate optimization solutions for the benefit of clients and industry. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travelling and has an analytical mind.


All resumes must be in english.


Responsibilities

  • Development, deployment, and integration of Advanced Regulatory Control applications
  • Support deployment and integration of Expert Systems
  • Analyze and troubleshoot control system issues and provide solutions to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Experience commissioning and tuning of control systems.
  • Produce technical documentation (e.G., reports, manuals, specifications, drawings)
  • Conduct data analyses.

title: Finance Manager (Brazil)
description:
The Finance Manager will oversee all financial, accounting, and tax functions for the Brazilian entity, ensuring compliance with local statutory requirements, tax regulations, and corporate reporting standards. The role encompasses daily accounting operations, month-end and year-end closings, and statutory audits, while providing management with financial analysis, budgeting support, and strategic guidance. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical accounting expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to excel in a fast-paced start-up environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the maintenance of accurate financial reports and accounting records in line with corporate guidelines, corporate timelines and local statutory requirements.
  • Manage the full spectrum of the accounting functions, including accounts payables, accounts receivables, balance sheet schedules, general ledger maintenance, and cash flow management.
  • Manage closing processes and preparation of accurate and timely financial reports and analysis of financial information.
  • Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and municipal tax obligations.
  • Manage tax incentives including PPB (Processo Produtivo Básico) and tax optimization opportunities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax laws.
  • Coordinate and liaise with external parties (e.G. banks, external auditors, tax agents, corporate secretarial agents, local tax and government authorities) to ensure smooth operations.
  • Collaborate across departments in preparing and managing the OPEX budgets.
  • Identify and implement process improvements in internal accounting and financial operations efficiency.
  • Partner with business units to provide finance-related advice.
  • Coordinate with headquarters to align local reporting with group consolidation requirements.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in finance and tax management, including 3+ years in an international setting.
  • Knowledge of Direct and Indirect tax.
  • Advanced analytical skills and high attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact with all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to work independently, manage pressure, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • Prior experience in accounting firms is an added advantage.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
Job Description
Your Career
The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.
You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies.
Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information
The Team
Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.
As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Business Intelligence Partner
description:
Business Intelligence Partner

Location: Sao Paulo Brazil


about Randstad Enterprise

Randstad Sourceright is a global talent leader, providing solutions and expertise that help companies position for growth, execute on strategy, and improve business agility. Our experience encompasses all facets of the talent acquisition of permanent employees and the contingent and contractor workforce. Key offerings include Managed Services Provider (MSP) programs, Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO), and Blended Workforce Solutions. Randstad Sourceright offers solutions Globally in North America, EMEA, and APAC. Working for a multi-country organization means working with clients and colleagues from different backgrounds. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive and culturally inclusive mindset.


job context

and purpose


Purpose of the job

This role aims to partner with the Regional and global BI customers within RSR (who can include but are not limited to Data engineering, BI Support Teams, Operational Teams, Internal teams, and RSR clients) and provide business solutions through data.

This position has operational and technical responsibility for reporting, analytics, and visualization dashboards across all operating companies within RSR. This position will develop processes and strategies to consolidate, automate, and improve reporting and dashboards for external clients and internal stakeholders.

As a Business Intelligence Partner, you will oversee the end-to-end delivery of regional and global account and client BI reporting. This will include working with data engineering to provide usable datasets, creating dashboards with meaningful insights & visualizations within our BI solution, and ongoing communication and partnering with the ‘BI consumers. Must be knowledgeable in Tableau and SQL. The key to this is that as a Business Intelligence Partner, you will be a commercial and operational expert who can translate data into insights. You will use this to mitigate risk, find operational and revenue-generating opportunities, and provide business solutions.


Key stakeholders

  • RSR internal stakeholders include but are not limited to C-Suite, Finance, Regional Managing Directors, Vice Presidents, and operational account leaders.
  • RSR external clients


Position Summary

Development of BI solutions (50%):

  • Responsible for delivering BI solutions for the program
  • Responsible for ensuring all contractual conditions around reporting, financial elements, SLA's, and KPI's are reviewed, understood, and adhered to
  • Assess operating reality to validate solution requirements and adjust as needed.
  • Implement and reinforce tools, including standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Ensure the team has living documentation on reporting requirements, data processes, and other program-specific content.
  • Oversee the design and build of insightful, scalable, and actionable visualizations.
  • Develop, document, and maintain a comprehensive quality management program
  • Build, implement, and schedule production standards of files and reports to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Ensure reporting quality and accuracy by evaluating, integrating, and complementing data sources.
  • Execute continuous process improvement process.
  • Knowledge of general database functions, data storage, data models, SQL, and data transfer protocols

Consult (30%):

  • Responsible for being the liaison between the external client, operations teams and the wider BI teams
  • Using client data and insights to highlight and provide observations, provide recommendations, and contribute to ongoing business discussions and decision-making.
  • Analyze the client’s data to present the account leadership and client with potential approaches or opportunities for improving service delivery performance and elevating value-added opportunities.
  • Have commercial awareness and work with the account leadership to maximize revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Solicit feedback from internal and external stakeholders in an organized manner to contribute to the objectives of the BI team and demonstrate RSR value.
  • Contribute to the success of a wider global team.
  • Qualify the business needs of each request and use expertise to partner on solutions.
  • Develop strong working relationships with the client stakeholders and account leads.
  • Serve as a functional and technical data visualization and business intelligence subject matter expert.

Maintain Standards (20%):

  • Work within the agreed parameters aligned to the global method of BI production
  • Leverage an agile work environment to incorporate new innovative and value components into existing portfolios
  • Organize a feedback standard from stakeholders (internal and external) in order to create use case, case study materials and other customer-facing material
  • Promote available resources and enterprise tools for operations training/ coaching needs from a BI perspective.
  • Ensure data governance principles and guidelines are being met


job

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required;
    Master’s degree a plus

Mandatory Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a similar role
  • Project Management and/or process improvement experience

  • Proficient with an ANSI-compliant SQL dialect
  • Proven experience with Tableau dashboard development
  • Ability to turn ambiguous information and unstructured challenges into substantive insights.

Preferred Experience:

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated continuous improvement, process documentation, and workflow skills
  • Excellent working knowledge of MS - Excel with knowledge of macros and pivot tables.

  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects, tasks, and meet deadlines while maintaining quality
  • Ability to synthesize and analyze information and ideas

    ability to interpret data and translate it to non-tech people.

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team


We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience.


Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:

Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.

IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.

Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.


Our Core Focuses:

End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.

Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.

Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.

We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.G., power, HVAC, fire suppression).

2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations.

3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion.

4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs.

5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance.

6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions.

7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.G., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives.


Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline.

2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role;
experience in multinational corporations preferred.

3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems.

4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation.

5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance.

6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness.

7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.G., PMP, CFM) are a plus.

9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

title: Workday Recruiting And Talent Analyst
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst



About the Role

As a key member of our Workday Application Management Support team, the Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst will own the configuration, maintenance, and support of our Recruiting, Talent, Performance and Learning modules.

You will partner closely with HR and Talent Acquisition Teams to ensure Workday solutions align with evolving business needs, legal / regulatory requirements, and employee experience goals.

This role requires deep functional expertise in Workday configuration, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate HR and Recruiting requirements into scalable Workday solutions.




Key Responsibilities

  • Maximize the effectiveness of Workday by configuring, maintaining, and continuously optimizing Workday Recruiting, Talent, Performance, and Learning modules.
  • Enable better talent decisions and development by supporting scalable, user-friendly solutions for career growth, goal tracking, and feedback collection.
  • Enhance the candidate and employee experience by resolving issues and queries that impact usability, accuracy, or workflow across recruiting and talent modules.
  • Drive the success of the annual performance review cycle by owning the configuration, launch, monitoring, and post-cycle review of performance processes, while identifying opportunities for process and system improvements.
  • Ensure data accuracy and process scalability by preparing, loading, and validating EIBs for mass data updates.
  • Maximize system performance and adoption by evaluating new Workday releases, identifying relevant enhancements, and recommending high-impact improvements to stakeholders.
  • Ensure system reliability and business continuity by proactively monitoring health and resolving issues across Recruiting and Talent modules.
  • Improve transparency and knowledge sharing by maintaining clear, user-friendly documentation for configurations, business processes, and system policies.
  • Accelerate continuous improvement initiatives through cross-functional collaboration with analysts, IT teams, HR, Talent Acquisition and business stakeholders, delivering enhancements that add value and reduce manual effort.
  • Safeguard data integrity and compliance by ensuring configurations align with internal governance, audit requirements, and security standards.
  • Enhance user confidence and self-service adoption by contributing to the development of end-user training materials in partnership with HR.



Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of hands-on Workday configuration experience, with expertise in Recruiting, Talent, Performance and Learning modules.
  • Strong understanding of HR and Recruiting policies.
  • Experience with Workday business processes, security roles related to Recruiting, Talent, and change management.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in EIBs and data management within Workday.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to translate technical configurations to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and process integrity.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver quality results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent English.



Preferred:

  • Workday certification(s) in HCM, Recruiting, Talent, Performance or Learning.
  • Experience supporting Workday release cycles and testing activities.
  • Familiarity with Workday reporting basics, including calculated fields and report writer.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados

  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe;
    Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua

title: Coordenador Fiscal - Torre De Faturamento
description:
Briefing da posição:


Como Coordenador/Supervisor Fiscal da Torre de Faturamento, o profissional será responsável por liderar a operação fiscal vinculada ao faturamento da empresa (“torre” de faturamento), assegurando o correto processamento de notas fiscais, apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos, cumprimento de obrigações acessórias, e a entrega de resultados por meio de KPIs.


Espera-se perfil de liderança, domínio técnico e capacidade de interface executiva (internamente com Financeiro, Faturamento, Contabilidade, Comercial, e externamente com clientes). O inglês avançado será requisito para interação com equipes globais ou clientes internacionais.


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Coordenar as atividades da torre de faturamento: emissão e conferência de notas fiscais (saídas/entradas), conferência de faturamento, retenções, XML, NFS-e/NF-e, CTe, etc.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de obrigações acessórias: SPED Fiscal, SPED Contribuições, DCTF, EFD-Contribuições, REINF, ECF/ECD, etc;
  • Implantar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da operação fiscal/faturamento (por exemplo: % de notas com erro fiscal, tempo de processamento, custo por nota, índice de credits fiscais aproveitados, SLA de faturamento, conformidade) e reportar à liderança executiva;
  • Desenvolver e liderar a equipe da torre (coordenados e analistas), promovendo treinamento, engajamento, definição de metas, monitoramento de performance e melhorias contínuas de processo;
  • Interface com Financeiro, Contabilidade, Comercial/Vendas, TI/ERP e auditoria, assegurando que as operações de faturamento estejam alinhadas aos controles internos, aos requisitos de compliance e às estratégias de negócio;
  • Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de melhoria de processos, automação, mapeamento de riscos fiscais, aproveitamento de créditos, e adaptação a mudanças da legislação (como reforma tributária, por exemplo) ou cenários de negócio;
  • Apresentar análises gerenciais e relatórios executivos (em inglês, quando for o caso) à alta direção ou matriz, com propostas de ação, acompanhamento de metas e suportes decisórios.


Qualificações & requisitos:


  • Formação superior em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Preferencialmente com registro CRC ativo (quando aplicável);
  • Experiência sólida em operação fiscal/tributária, com apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos em ambiente corporativo;
  • Experiência comprovada em faturamento ou faturamento tributário (emissão de notas fiscais, retenções, faturamento em operação com produtos/serviços) e liderança de equipe;
  • Inglês avançado (oral e escrito) – para reportes, interface com clientes estrangeiros;
  • Perfil forte deliderança, com habilidades executivas — comunicação clara, capacidade de influenciar, visibilidade junto à diretoria, visão de negócio;
  • Familiaridade com KPIs, dashboards, relatórios gerenciais, e métricas de performance da área fiscal/faturamento;
  • Atuação em ambiente de alta demanda, com foco em prazos, entregas, auditorias e mudanças regulatórias;


Competências comportamentais:


  • Visão estratégica com mindset operacional (“hands-on”);
  • Alta capacidadeanalítica e atenção a detalhes;
  • Orientação pararesultados e melhoria contínua;
  • Excelente comunicação (com a equipe, stakeholders e diretoria);
  • Adaptabilidade e proatividade para lidar com mudanças rápidas (ex: reforma tributária, nova legislação);
  • Integridade, postura ética e foco em compliance;


Se você é um líder fiscal com visão estratégica, domínio técnico e capacidade de transformar operações através de performance, governança e indicadores, esta posição pode ser a oportunidade ideal para direcionar resultados com impacto direto no negócio.

title: Government Relations Director, Brazil
description:
SHEIN

Founded in 2012, SHEIN is a leading global online retailer, with operations in Guangzhou,

Singapore, Los Angeles, and other key markets around the world. SHEIN reaches consumers


in more than 150 locations globally, enabling them to access more fashion, beauty and

lifestyle products easily and conveniently, at affordable prices. Our mission is to help

everyone - regardless of their location, body size, ethnicity, income level - express their

individuality through access to the latest trends.


SHEIN works with outstanding, creative and highly capable peers. Our culture is energetic,

collaborative and open to new ideas and suggestions, enabling outstanding individuals to

come together and ignite new possibilities as a team. SHEIN welcomes passionate and

enthusiastic individuals to join us in driving SHEIN’s growth and expansion globally, making

it possible for everyone to wear and live their most wonderful lives.


Summary of Role

The successful candidate will be responsible for driving the analysis and providing

assessment of relevant public policy issues and their implications on SHEIN’s business

interests in Brazil. He/she is responsible for fostering strategic partnerships with key

stakeholders and translating policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to

advance SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil. He/she will also plan,

organise and manage SHEIN’s various stakeholder engagement platforms in Brazil, in

support of the objective to expand and enhance our collaborations with key stakeholders from various backgrounds such as political/regulatory stakeholders, civil society, industry

associations and other public arenas.


In this role, the candidate must be able to work effectively with various teams, including the Customer Service, Sustainability, Legal, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams, to advance

SHEIN’s corporate interests in Brazil. He/she should possess a deep interest and ability to

understand how politics, business, fashion, sustainability, technology and innovation, as well as international relations are interconnected.


Job Responsibilities

  • Track, monitor and assess strategic/policy issues and their implications to SHEIN’s commercial interests in Brazil.
  • Develop and provide recommendations to SHEIN’s senior management and relevant business units concerning political, policy, and regulatory issues.
  • Identify, engage and build relations with key stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, non-governmental organizations, media, and industry associations) to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts in Brazil.
  • Identify and map key policy stakeholders (including political office holders, government officials, regulators, international organisations, non-governmental organisations and industry associations).
  • Develop and drive engagement strategies to reach out and build strategic relationships with key stakeholders to strengthen SHEIN’s network of partners.
  • Formulate and execute advocacy plans to translate policy engagements into tangible commercial outcomes to secure SHEIN’s market access and expansion efforts.
  • Develop and drive strategic communications plans and partnerships in support of company’s overall policy positioning and profiling.
  • Organise and manage meetings with external parties, including the preparation of briefing notes/presentations for senior management’s reference.
  • Lead in the planning, organisation and management of networking platforms


Required Qualifications and Experience

  • Degree in International Relations, Political Science, Global Studies, Law, Economics, Communications, Media, Journalism, or related fields.
  • At least 10 years of working experience in corporate/public affairs, and/or government relations/public policy, and/or corporate communications/public relations.
  • Experience in policy research, development, and analysis, and/or track record in developing and implementing external communication strategies/campaigns
  • Strong policy/regulatory network and/or media relations in Brazil.
  • Strong analytical, presentation (written and oral), and project management skills.
  • Good knowledge and experience in digital media tools/platforms
  • Strong proficiency in English and Portuguese;
    Spanish preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and have exceptional attention to detail while operating in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

title: Lower School Makerspace Teacher
description:
EARJ is looking for an experienced and accomplished Lower School Makerspace Teacher to join our team at Gávea campus (July 2026).

The Lower School Makerspace Teacher is a dynamic and innovative educator who fosters creativity, collaboration, critical thinking, and problem-solving through hands-on STEM learning experiences. As an IB World School, we are looking for an educator who can seamlessly integrate maker-centered learning with the Primary Years Programme (PYP) curriculum. Working closely with classroom teachers and specialists, this educator will design and facilitate engaging, inquiry-based projects that nurture innovation, design thinking, a maker mindset, and strong foundations in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) for students from Kindergarten to Grade 5.

The ideal candidate is:

  • Holds a Bachelor’s degree in Pedagogy and Arts, Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics.
  • Has 3–5 years of qualified teaching experience, preferably in an international school context.
  • A skillful and creative practitioner in multilingual and interdisciplinary classrooms.
  • A motivated learner who takes responsibility for their own professional growth.
  • Someone who thrives in an environment of transformational leadership.
  • Passionate about innovation, creativity, and hands-on, inquiry-based learning.
  • Skilled in high-impact 21st-century instructional practices, integrating technology, design thinking, and the arts.
  • And, most importantly, teaches students, not just subjects.

If you are culturally open-minded and have an optimistic growth mindset, then EARJ is the place where you can make a difference. Join a community that is inclusive, culturally sensitive, and equitable, where everyone experiences a strong sense of belonging.

title: Assistente De Contas A Pagar
description:
Resumo da Função

Buscamos um Analista de Contas a Pagar que eleve o padrão financeiro da Marjom. Alguém rigoroso com detalhes, rápido na execução, dono das entregas e capaz de sustentar um fluxo sólido entre fábrica, fornecedores e diretoria. É uma cadeira estratégica para garantir previsibilidade, controle e saúde financeira.

Responsabilidades

  • Executar todo o fluxo de contas a pagar: conferência, classificação, programação e pagamentos.
  • Validar notas fiscais, boletos, retenções e impostos obrigatórios (ISS, INSS, IR, PIS/COFINS/CSLL).
  • Controlar vencimentos e montar a previsão de pagamentos semanal e mensal.
  • Realizar conciliações bancárias diárias e garantir acuracidade dos saldos.
  • Alimentar e atualizar planilhas e dashboards financeiros, assegurando consistência dos dados.
  • Manter relacionamento claro e profissional com fornecedores, negociando prazos quando necessário.
  • Acompanhar o fluxo de aprovação interna (diretoria, controladoria e demais áreas).
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas com documentação organizada e rastreável.
  • Contribuir para melhorias de processo, automatizações e aumento de eficiência.

Qualificações Técnicas

  • Experiência sólida em contas a pagar, financeiro ou controladoria.
  • Domínio de Excel/Google Sheets (PROCV/XLOOKUP, Tabela Dinâmica, fórmulas de análise).
  • Conhecimento de ERPs — desejável experiência com sistemas de indústria.
  • Entendimento de rotinas fiscais e contábeis.
  • Capacidade de montar previsões de fluxo de caixa e análises de variações.
  • Organização extrema e atenção a detalhes — nada passa despercebido.
  • Visão numérica forte e conforto com grandes volumes de dados.

Competências Interpessoais

  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e madura — sabe explicar problemas e alternativas.
  • Postura de dono: assume, resolve e entrega no prazo.
  • Agilidade e capacidade de priorizar em cenários de pressão.
  • Relacionamento respeitoso e colaborativo com times internos e fornecedores.
  • Disciplina e constância — mantém o ritmo mesmo em semanas críticas.
  • Curiosidade e mentalidade de melhoria contínua.
  • Alta confiabilidade e ética — lida com informações sensíveis diariamente.

Como este cargo se encaixa na Marjom

Esta função sustenta a operação financeira da empresa e é peça-chave para tomada de decisão. O Analista de Contas a Pagar garante previsibilidade, protege caixa, fortalece relações com fornecedores e cria uma base segura para o crescimento da companhia.

title: Analista Fiscal Pleno
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.

Estamos com oportunidades para ANALISTA FISCAL PLENO para a região de LIMEIRA/SÃO PAULO.

#VemSerAgropalma


Descrição Breve do Cargo:

Responsável por realizar apurações fiscais (ICMS , IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS), escrituração e conferência de documentos fiscais, garantindo o cumprimento da legislação vigente. Atuará com obrigações acessórias (SPED Fiscal , EFD-Contribuições, DCTF, DIRF, etc.), análise de contas contábeis de tributos, apoio na fiscalização e auditorias, além de atendimento às áreas internas e órgãos reguladores. Apuração de tributos diretos e indiretos;
Elaboração e entrega deobrigações acessórias;
Análise e conciliação de contas fiscais;
Suporte à contabilidadee área financeira;
Atualização constante sobre a legislação tributária;
Atendimento à auditoriae fiscalização.


Instrução

  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou áreas correlatas;


Localidade

  • Limeira/SP
  • Americana/SP


Nossa Empresa

Somos a maior produtora de óleo sustentável da América Latina, reconhecida em todo o mundo pela qualidade superior de nossos produtos e processos, e pelo compromisso com o meio ambiente e as pessoas. Geramos cerca de 5mil empregos diretos e desenvolvemos projetos socioambientais que impactam direta e indiretamente na vida de todos.


Temos operações no Pará e em São Paulo. Nossos plantios e fábricas de extração ficam situados em Tailândia/PA, onde iniciamos nossa trajetória em 1982. Também possuímos modernas refinarias nas cidades de Belém/PA e Limeira/SP. Especificamente, na unidade de Limeira, temos uma refinaria multióleos, com equipamentos de última geração e um Centro de Inovação pronto para atender às indústrias de panificação, sorvetes, confeitaria, food service, lácteos, cosméticos e produtos não alimentícios (químicos e oleoquímicos).


Mais do que desenvolver produtos de qualidade, nosso objetivo é cooperar para um mundo melhor. Tanto que dos nossos 107 mil hectares de terra, destinamos 64 mil a áreas de reservas florestais preservadas e monitoradas, com riquíssima biodiversidade. Em Tailândia/PA, mantemos agrovilas com completa infraestrutura para nossos colaboradores, com escola, clubes e academia.

title: System Engineer
description:

- Participar desde o design de microsserviços, passando pela codificação até o deployment do serviço em produção

Requisitos:

- Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento com Java, Kotlin e Python e framework Spring Boot;

- Conhecimento emcontrole de versão com Git;

- Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);

- Capacidade de identificar e resolver problemas complexos;

- Boa comunicaçãoe trabalho em equipe.

Desejável:

- Desejável experiência em Metodologias ágeis e práticas Lean.

Diferenciais:

- Experiência com microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas;

- Certificações AWS;

- Experiência comIA;

- Experiência em ambientes de alta disponibilidade e missão crítica;

- Conhecimento emsistemas de pagamentos Core.

SoftSkill

- Comunicativo, responsável, colaborativo e inovador Hands On,

- Autodidata e estar atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e tendências

- Visão sistêmica e de riscos com foco em soluções Visão de tecnologia integrada ao negócio e ao cliente

- Atitude de dono, Capacidade analítica, Colaboração, Comunicação verbal,

- Foco em resultados, Foco na performance, Foco no cliente.

- Motivação em aprender coisas novas,

- Organização, Paixão por desafios, Paixão por tecnologia,

- Proatividade, Raciocínio Lógico, Relacionamento interpessoal, Resiliência e flexibilidade,

Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.

Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

title: Elementary Homeroom Teacher In Mexico City - Native English Speaker
description:
The Churchill School & College Mexico City is looking to appoint an enthusiastic and committed Primary Teacher to work with a dedicated team in the Primary department (KS2) to start in AUGUST 2026.


The Churchill School & College, part of The Anglo Foundation, offers bilingual education for students aged 2 to 18. It is an authorized center for IB (Primary Years, Middle Years, Diploma) and Cambridge (Primary, Lower Secondary, Upper Secondary) programs.

Located in Mexico City, a vibrant and culturally rich metropolis, the school provides teachers with housing in a popular residential area near the campus, with easy access to restaurants, shopping, theaters, and public transportation.


The successful applicant for this position will:

  • Hold a BA Degree in Education (mandatory)
  • Be a Native English Speaker (mandatory)
  • Be passionate about teaching and learning
  • Hold a relevant degree and Qualified Teacher Status or equivalent
  • Have at least two years of teaching experience
  • Have experience in, or knowledge of, IB and Cambridge programmes (preferred)
  • Be able to engage and motivate students
  • Use assessment for learning tools, adapting instruction to individual needs
  • Seek to consistently improve their practice
  • Promote the values of the school
  • Thrive in an inclusive school environment


In return, we will offer you:

- students who are inquirers and highly motivated by dynamic teaching

- well-educated parents who are committed to the school and their children’s learning

- personal and professional development opportunities, including career growth within the school and under the umbrella of The Anglo Foundation

- a competitive salary (with additional benefits)

- an accommodation allowance

- a flight allowance

- an initial 2-year contract (renewable annually thereafter)

- private health insurance, including comprehensive dental care

- an excellent working environment with supportive and committed staff


APPLICATION PROCESS

If you would like to be part of the Churchill family, we look forward to receiving your application.
